title: Finite pushforward preserves quasi-coherence and finite type without Noetherian assumptions
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite morphism of schemes [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], [def-pc-scheme]. Let $F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_Y$-module of finite type [pqf-def-coherent]. Then $f_*F$ [def-pc-module-pullback] is quasi-coherent and of finite type. No Noetherian hypothesis on either scheme is required.

source.place: Tags 01Y6 (finite scalar restriction argument) and 01LC (quasi-coherent pushforward); the finite-type argument does not require Noetherianity

proof.text: Finite morphisms are affine, hence quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Apply the existing qcqs pushforward theorem to prove quasi-coherence of f_*F.

Restriction preserves finite local generators. Choose local generators q of F and pull the generating cover back along Over.forget U. Index the new cover by triples (V,i,G(V)->q.X(i)); the covering lifting property makes it cover the slice. Each iterated slice pushforward preserves colimits and the unit because its ring map is an identity and its underlying functor is cocontinuous. Map the generating epimorphism along that functor. Its unchanged finite indexing type proves finite type of F.over U. This is the explicit local-generator construction, not an appeal to a duplicate scheme restriction theorem.

Over every affine open U of X, f inverse U is affine. The affine finite-type criterion applied to its restricted module gives finite sections over B=O_Y(f inverse U). Finite f makes B finite over A=O_X(U). The direct-image sections are the same group with A acting through f.app U. The scalar tower compatibility is definitional, and Module.Finite.trans makes these sections finite over A.

Apply the affine finite-type criterion to the covering of X by all affine opens and the finiteness just proved. This gives finite type of the quasi-coherent pushforward. Pair the two conclusions. Empty affine opens and zero modules satisfy the same argument; no source or target Noetherianity is assumed.

theorem isQuasicoherent_and_isFiniteType_pushforward_of_isFinite
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] (F : Y.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [F.IsFiniteType] :
    ((pushforward f).obj F).IsQuasicoherent ∧ ((pushforward f).obj F).IsFiniteType
